title: Eka
text: 2 Ekena ca kho bhikkhave balena samannāgato puriso mātugāmam abhibhūyya vattati || katamena ekena balena || || Issariyabalena || || 3 Issariyabalena abhibhūtam bhikkhave mātugāmaṃ neva rūpabalaṃ tāyati na bhogabalaṃ tāyati na ñātibalaṃ tāyati na puttabalaṃ tāyati na sīlabalaṃ tāyatīti || || [page 247] XXXVII. 30. 2] VAGGO TATIYO 247
